semantic_scope.fixed_key: All ten relevant library executions contain the exact new wire test actual ok. One genuine proof fixture, fixed circuit/key identity, fresh independent empty caches, four concurrent cold verifiers using the already initialized immutable public key, decodable proof/signature mutations rejected as Authorization and not memoized, valid-byte behavior retained. C7 strict Clippy completes with no duplicate_mod; fixture implementation and full test body are unchanged. No cold OnceLock initialization race claim.
semantic_scope.archive_and_replay: Archive cases run 18 on Ubuntu/17 on Windows; each copy production path retains source, target and final-source full replay with new per-instance authorization cache, plus independent checkpoint export replay. Real process lock and platform namespace/handle cases execute on the applicable platform.
semantic_scope.funded_flow: Both funded libraries run all four active_flow cases. Growth uses genuine payments, real default-segment rotation, 10001 payment, exact backup/restore and continuation to 10002. The unchanged unconditional existing-segment-swap regression checks original pin and fully recomputed pin both return Corrupt with byte/namespace preservation; physical layout matches repin before chain/order rejection. Separate real bad binding signature with recomputed record checksum and pin explicitly returns Authorization in ordinary open and ActiveArchive.
semantic_scope.cli: Both exact C7 interfaces cohorts execute all seven CLI tests, including two genuine payment-proof builds in the payment/restore/receiver-spend case. The complete seventh case executes all four readonly File stdout modes with a real failed-write probe and exact exit1, writable-file JSON positive control, immutable source/sink, byte-complete backup/restore targets and separate posterior verification.
limits: Windows NULL-handle guard lacks a dedicated runtime fixture.

limitations: Native acceptance covers the exact source/tree and observed lab matrix, not a universal absence-of-bugs guarantee or production funds/security approval.
Default feature-gated active CLI zero cases do not count as funded seven cases.
File.flush is not fsync; Windows NULL handle guard lacks dedicated runtime fixture; no real power-loss/disk-full/full-capacity claim.
New fixed public key concurrency uses an already initialized key; no cold OnceLock initialization race coverage.
Funded interfaces and TestRealOperatorNonzeroPaymentsAndRestart pay A->B->C before full restart; post-full-restart new operator payment belongs to TestActiveFundedFourNodePaymentRestart.
Growth is 99998 empty + 2 paid local worker commits at height100000; recovered height100001 is empty, not 100000 payments or four-node growth.
Resources are measured process OS memory with explicit retained-identity cleanup boundaries; reported result_sha256 not independently recomputed from unavailable original result.json.
Operator binary ZIPs verified locally but not embedded in evidence Git; no notice inventory or distribution/license audit.
Frozen design document retains known EOF blank-line whitespace diagnostic; no claim all stage files have zero whitespace diagnostics.
